description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Model identity readings from models.dev, raw readings first. For one models.dev entry (provider + model, e.g. anthropic + claude-sonnet-4-5): knowledge cutoff, the dated version it maps to (models.dev canonical id; dated versions found only by naming are marked inferred), context and output limits, and recorded change events (pointer, cutoff, context, new, removed), each with its timestamp. With provider only: that provider's entries; with neither: providers and the last 7 days of changes. Data: models.dev (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 models.dev), full notice and fetch time in every response; not affiliated with models.dev or any model vendor. Unknown ids get an error before any payment. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

model.description: models.dev model key under that provider, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5 (may contain /); needs provider

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
